extracted.intended_audience: Principal investigators, institutional grants administrators, and other applicants preparing PHS 398 grant applications to NIH/HHS
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing and assembling a grant application using the PHS 398 (Revised 03/2020) instructions and form files, including human subjects/clinical trials, biosketches, budgets, and related attachments for either paper or electronic submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the PHS 398 (Revised 03/2020) instructions and form files
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications using PHS 398 must use the revised 03/2020 instructions and the associated form files.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Download the current PHS 398 Instructions and Fillable Forms (Revised 03/2020). Notable changes are listed on the page (updated 03/16/2021).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use fillable individual PHS 398 forms only for paper submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: The fillable PDF samples provided for individual PHS 398 forms are to be used only with paper submissions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not use the PDF samples provided in an SF424 (R&R) electronic application — they will cause an error in electronic submission. For appropriate electronic formats, see the How to Apply - Application Guide.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow How to Apply - Application Guide for electronic submission formats
rubrics_metrics.description: The Application Guide prescribes the formats and file types appropriate for electronic submission (SF424 (R&R)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to the How to Apply - Application Guide rather than using the fillable PDFs when submitting electronically.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comply with type size and format specifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Type size and format specifications must be met for application materials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Other software packages may be used to prepare application materials, but if the type size and format specifications are not met the application processing may be delayed or the application may be returned without review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Be aware of Combined PHS 398 Forms file contents and exclusions
rubrics_metrics.description: The combined PHS 398 forms file is provided but does NOT include certain pages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The combined file does not include the Biographical Sketch page, Continuation Page, or any of the Sample/Example pages (Biosketch Sample, Other Support Sample). Use the individual form file links where those are required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the PHS Human Subjects and Clinical Trials Information form for consolidated human subjects/trial data
rubrics_metrics.description: There is a new consolidated form for human subjects, inclusion enrollment report, and clinical trial information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This consolidated form includes attachments to comply with the NIH Policy on the Use of a Single Institutional Review Board for Multi-Site Research and reflects updated appendix policy and clinical trial-related changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide the ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier where required
rubrics_metrics.description: The PHS Human Subjects and Clinical Trials Information form now includes a field to provide the ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the updated instructions for when and how to provide the identifier.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow updated instructions for Section 2 — Study Population Characteristics
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 2 instructions now reflect updated exceptions for required questions about study population characteristics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Read and apply the revised exceptions and question guidance in Section 2 when completing the form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include a Study Timeline
rubrics_metrics.description: The Human Subjects and Clinical Trials form requires a Study Timeline entry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Study Timeline field as instructed on the form to summarize key study milestones and timing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Answer the multi-site protocol question and follow single IRB instructions (Section 3.2)
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 3.2 asks whether the study is a multi-site study that will use the same protocol to conduct non-exempt human subjects research at more than one domestic site and provides updated instructions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the updated instructions regarding the single IRB plan attachment and multi-site considerations. Instructions include specifics for AHRQ applicants where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide a Data and Safety Monitoring Plan attachment when required
rubrics_metrics.description: Updated instructions for the Data and Safety Monitoring Plan attachment are included on the form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: There are updated instructions for delayed onset studies and guidance regarding the use of a single IRB. See form instructions for when a monitoring plan attachment is required and what it must contain.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include 'Inclusion of Individuals Across the Lifespan' attachment when applicable
rubrics_metrics.description: A new attachment for 'Inclusion of Individuals Across the Lifespan' has been added to the Human Subjects and Clinical Trials form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this attachment to document plans for inclusion across the lifespan as required by the form instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use separate 'Inclusion of Women and Minorities' attachment (updated)
rubrics_metrics.description: Instructions for the 'Inclusion of Women and Minorities' attachment have been updated and are separate from the new lifespan inclusion attachment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the updated guidance specific to this attachment when documenting inclusion of women and minorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide the Inclusion Enrollment Report Title field when required
rubrics_metrics.description: A new 'Inclusion Enrollment Report Title' field has been added to the form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete this field as instructed where inclusion enrollment reporting is required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use 'Detailed Description' field instead of removed 'Brief Summary' field
rubrics_metrics.description: The form removed the 'Brief Summary' field and changed the 'Narrative Study' field to 'Detailed Description.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the study description in the 'Detailed Description' field per the updated form layout and instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify whether the application is an applicable clinical trial under FDAAA
rubrics_metrics.description: A new field asks 'Is this an applicable clinical trial under FDAAA?' and must be completed as applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Answer this question and follow any resulting instructions for applicable clinical trials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account for renumbered form fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Form fields have been renumbered in the updated forms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be sure to reference the updated field numbers when completing or cross-referencing form sections and attachments.

rubrics_metrics.name: List only scientific/professional graduate courses for scholastic performance on the Biographical Sketch
rubrics_metrics.description: Biosketch instructions were updated so that scholastic performance requires only scientific/professional graduate courses to be listed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the updated biosketch instructions when preparing Biographical Sketch pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS Inclusion Enrollment Report discontinued; data moved to new form
rubrics_metrics.description: The separate PHS Inclusion Enrollment Report has been discontinued and its data collection moved to the new PHS Human Subjects and Clinical Trials Information form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not submit the discontinued report; instead use the consolidated human subjects/trials form and associated attachments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Updated appendix policy eliminates clinical trial–related materials from allowable appendices
rubrics_metrics.description: The updated appendix policy eliminates clinical trial–related materials from allowable appendix items.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to the NIH Guide Notice on Allowable Appendix Materials for detail on what may or may not be included in appendices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget form specific fix (Form Page 4) — Row 7 Total editable field
rubrics_metrics.description: Form Page 4: Detailed Budget for Initial Budget Period had a fix: the Row 7 Total field in the Personnel section is an editable form field.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be aware that the Row 7 Total field is editable; use the corrected form file.
